_comment: The promo video's narration, scene by scene. This file is the script:
edit the text here and re-render, no code changes needed.
id        matches a <section data-scene="id"> in storyboard.html
say       what the voice reads. `[[slnc N]]` inserts an N-millisecond
pause; it is macOS `say` markup, not spoken.
caption   the same line as plain text, for the .srt subtitle file
lead      silence before the line starts, seconds (the scene animates in)
tail      silence after the line ends, seconds (the scene holds)
Scene length is lead + spoken length + tail, measured at render time, so
the picture always follows the voice rather than a hand-written duration.

scenes.say: We all work on more than one project.
scenes.caption: We all work on more than one project.

scenes.say: You keep working on your own machine. [[slnc 260]] And you can add another, with its own credentials and its own level of access.
scenes.caption: You keep working on your own machine. And you can add another, with its own credentials and its own level of access.

scenes.say: Connect the machines, sign in with your accounts, [[slnc 200]] and begin work.
scenes.caption: Connect the machines, sign in with your accounts, and begin work.

scenes.say: Create a project and pick a template. [[slnc 240]] It runs on the machine you choose, using the accounts signed in there.
scenes.caption: Create a project and pick a template. It runs on the machine you choose, using the accounts signed in there.

scenes.say: Coding Lab is the one interface over all of it. [[slnc 300]] All your machines. [[slnc 240]] All your projects. [[slnc 240]] All your A I accounts, [[slnc 160]] and the ones you choose to share.
scenes.caption: Coding Lab is the one interface over all of it. All your machines. All your projects. All your AI accounts, and the ones you choose to share.

scenes.say: Work alongside your teammates, [[slnc 200]] and see the numbers: how you work, and how far the work has come.
scenes.caption: Work alongside your teammates, and see the numbers: how you work, and how far the work has come.

scenes.say: And keep it all in order, [[slnc 200]] with projects, sub-projects, and everything that belongs with them.
scenes.caption: And keep it all in order, with projects, sub-projects, and everything that belongs with them.

scenes.say: Coding Lab. [[slnc 380]] Start at coding dash lab dot co.
scenes.caption: Coding Lab. Start at coding-lab.co
